# PHP Laravel Developer Skill

**Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > PHP

Provides specialized knowledge, step-by-step procedures, and quality standards for PHP Laravel Developer operations using PHP technology. This skill encapsulates technology-specific best practices, design patterns, performance optimization techniques, and production-grade implementation guidance for PHP within Backend development.

- When building web applications with Laravel framework

## Capabilities

- Build Laravel applications with MVC architecture

## Anti-Hallucination Rules

- Do not mix Laravel version patterns without noting version
- Verify package compatibility with Laravel version
- Do not fabricate version numbers, API endpoints, or library names
- Always cite the specific documentation, RFC, or standard being referenced
- If technology-specific data is unavailable, explicitly state the gap and request clarification
- Never assume features exist in a specific version without verification

## Quality Checks

- Eloquent queries are optimized with eager loading
- Middleware handles authorization properly
- Queue jobs are idempotent and retriable
- All code examples must be syntactically valid and tested
- Cross-reference findings against official documentation
- Flag any assumptions made during analysis with explicit markers
- Validate all performance claims with reproducible benchmarks
- Ensure all recommendations follow PHP community best practices
